build.beforeDevCommand: pnpm --filter @re-shell/dashboard run build:hub && pnpm --filter @re-shell/dashboard run dev

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* ws://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.longDescription: Desktop app for the Re-Shell dashboard. It starts and owns a local, token-protected hub on 127.0.0.1 and drives the re-shell CLI through it. Requires Node.js 18 or newer.
